items.label: Ultra Comfort
items.value: Say goodbye to numb legs and sore backs. Our 13.5" extra-deep seat is 23% deeper than standard 11" stadium seats, so your thighs are fully supported — not hanging off the edge. The 2.8-inch thick 25D high-density foam cushion stays comfortable through 4+ hour football games, baseball doubleheaders, basketball tournaments, concerts, and graduation ceremonies without flattening out.

items.label: Lightweight & Portable
items.value: At just 5.8 pounds, this is one of the lightest full-size bleacher chairs you'll find. Two easy ways to carry: sling it over your shoulder with the adjustable padded strap, or grab the built-in carry handle for quick moves. Folds completely flat to 17" × 13.5" × 3" — slides right into your car trunk, closet, or behind the door. Even your kids can carry it.

items.label: 380 LB Heavy-Duty Support
items.value: Built to hold up to 380 lbs on a heavy-duty alloy steel frame with reinforced hinges. The 16.9-inch tall padded backrest provides full lower back and tailbone support — no more slouching or leaning on the person behind you. Whether you're a sports parent spending every weekend at the field, a grandparent at graduation, or someone who just needs real back support, this seat fits all body types comfortably.

items.label: Secure & Versatile
items.value: Locks securely onto metal, wood, and aluminum bleachers with 2 adjustable steel hooks plus wide non-slip rubber base strips — no sliding, no tipping backward. Also works perfectly on flat ground: concrete, grass, sand, or a boat deck. The 600D water-resistant Oxford fabric handles rain, spills, and sun exposure — just wipe clean with a damp cloth. Take it anywhere, use it on anything.

items.label: All-in-One Design
items.value: Built-in front organizer with mesh cup holder and storage pocket keeps your phone, keys, wallet, and drink within arm's reach — no more digging through bags. Available in 7 team-matching colors to show your spirit. Beyond the bleachers, it works great as a kayak seat, camping chair, or portable ground seat for outdoor concerts and picnics. Everything you need is in the box: seat, shoulder strap, and bleacher hooks.

items.label: Manufacturer Warranty Description
items.value: Sheenive provides a 30 day money back guarantee and a minimum one-year limited warranty on all our products from the date of purchase for the original retail buyer. Please retain your original delivery receipt as it will be necessary for any warranty claims. Our warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship for intended use only. If there is a defect, we will gladly send replacement parts or products to resolve the issue. For warranty or replacement product inquiries, please contact us directly at sheenive.
